knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

## Loading packages

```{r packages}
library(here)
library(haven)
library(readr)
```

```{r Reading Main Datasets}
Kenya_prelim <- 
  read_csv("Data/Processed/InitialProcessing/Kenya_filtered.csv")
Liberia_prelim <- read_csv("Data/Processed/InitialProcessing/Liberia_filtered.csv")
Niger_prelim <- read_csv("Data/Processed/InitialProcessing/Niger_filtered.csv")
Rwanda_prelim <- read_csv("Data/Processed/InitialProcessing/Rwanda_filtered.csv")
Zambia_prelim <- read_csv("Data/Processed/InitialProcessing/Zambia_filtered.csv")

```


```{r Grabbing the columns we need}

ColumnTitles <- list("HH_ID", "Subdivision1", "Subdivision2", "UrbanOrRural", "ElectrificationStatus", "HouseholdSize", "DwellingType", "DwellingOwnership", "DwellingRoomsNumber", "BankAccount", "GridConnected", "NumYearsGridConnected", "GridConnectionFeeLocal", "GridConnectionFeeUSD", "InternalWiringFeeLocal", "InternalWiringFeeUSD", "ElectricityBillPriceLocal", "ElectricityBillPriceUSD", "ElectricityConsumptionkWh", "OutageDurationHours", "MobilePhonesOwned", "WillingToPayForConnection", "EstimateOfElectricitySpendingLocal", "EstimateOfElectricitySpendingUSD")


Kenya_subset <- data.frame(
  Kenya_prelim[,c(1,2,3,6,7,9,11,12,13,14,15,17,18)],
  GridConnectionFeeUSD = NA,
  Kenya_prelim[,c(19)],
  InternalWiringFeeUSD = NA,
  Kenya_prelim[,c(20)],
  ElectricityBillPriceUSD = NA,
  Kenya_prelim[,c(21,22,23,25,30)],
  EstimateOfElectricitySpendingUSD = NA
)
colnames(Kenya_subset) <- ColumnTitles
Kenya_subset <- cbind(Country = "Kenya", Kenya_subset)

Rwanda_subset <- data.frame(
  Rwanda_prelim[,c(1,2,3)],
  UrbanOrRural = NA,
  ElectrificationStatus = NA,
  HouseholdSize = NA,
  Rwanda_prelim[,c(8,9,10,11,12,14,15)],
  GridConnectionFeeUSD = NA,
  Rwanda_prelim[,c(16)],
  InternalWiringFeeUSD = NA,
  Rwanda_prelim[,c(17)],
  ElectricityBillPriceUSD = NA,
  Rwanda_prelim[,c(18,19)],
  MobilePhonesOwned = NA,
  Rwanda_prelim[,c(22)],
  EstimateOfElectricitySpendingLocal = NA,
  EstimateOfElectricitySpendingUSD = NA
)
colnames(Rwanda_subset) <- ColumnTitles
Rwanda_subset <- cbind(Country = "Rwanda", Rwanda_subset)

Liberia_subset <- data.frame(
  Liberia_prelim[,c(1,3,4,5)],
  ElectrificationStatus = NA,
  Liberia_prelim[,c(6,8,9,10,11,12,14,15)],
  GridConnectionFeeUSD = NA,
  Liberia_prelim[,c(16)],
  InternalWiringFeeUSD = NA,
  Liberia_prelim[,c(17)],
  ElectricityBillPriceUSD = NA,
  Liberia_prelim[,c(18,19,20,22,27)],
  EstimateOfElectricitySpendingUSD = NA
)
colnames(Liberia_subset) <- ColumnTitles
Liberia_subset <- cbind(Country = "Liberia", Liberia_subset)

Niger_subset <- data.frame(
  Niger_prelim[,c(1,2,3,6,7,9,10,11,12,13,14,15,16)],
  GridConnectionFeeUSD = NA,
  Niger_prelim[,c(17)],
  InternalWiringFeeUSD = NA,
  Niger_prelim[,c(18)],
  ElectricityBillPriceUSD = NA,
  Niger_prelim[,c(19,20,21,23,26)],
  EstimateOfElectricitySpendingUSD = NA
)
colnames(Niger_subset) <- ColumnTitles
Niger_subset <- cbind(Country = "Niger", Niger_subset)


Zambia_subset <- data.frame(
  Zambia_prelim[,c(1,2,3,4)],
  ElectrificationStatus = NA,
  HouseholdSize = NA,
  Zambia_prelim[,c(9,10,11,12,13,15,16)],
  GridConnectionFeeUSD = NA,
  Zambia_prelim[,c(17)],
  InternalWiringFeeUSD = NA,
  Zambia_prelim[,c(18)],
  ElectricityBillPriceUSD = NA,
  Zambia_prelim[,c(19,20,21,22)],
  EstimateOfElectricitySpendingLocal = NA,
  EstimateOfElectricitySpendingUSD = NA
)
colnames(Zambia_subset) <- ColumnTitles
Zambia_subset <- cbind(Country = "Zambia", Zambia_subset)


ColumnTitles <- list("HH_ID", "Subdivision1", "Subdivision2", "UrbanOrRural", "ElectrificationStatus", "HouseholdSize", "DwellingType", "DwellingOwnership", "DwellingRoomsNumber", "BankAccount", "GridConnected", "NumYearsGridConnected", "GridConnectionFeeLocal", "GridConnectionFeeUSD", "InternalWiringFeeLocal", "InternalWiringFeeUSD", "ElectricityBillPriceLocal", "ElectricityBillPriceUSD", "ElectricityConsumptionkWh", "OutageDurationHours", "MobilePhonesOwned", "WillingToPayForConnection", "EstimateOfElectricitySpendingLocal", "EstimateOfElectricitySpendingUSD")

write.csv(Kenya_subset, "Data/Processed/FilteredToWorkingVariables/Kenya_Processed.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(Liberia_subset, "Data/Processed/FilteredToWorkingVariables/Liberia_Processed.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(Niger_subset, "Data/Processed/FilteredToWorkingVariables/Niger_Processed.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(Rwanda_subset, "Data/Processed/FilteredToWorkingVariables/Rwanda_Processed.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(Zambia_subset, "Data/Processed/FilteredToWorkingVariables/Zambia_Processed.csv", row.names = FALSE)


All_Combined <- rbind(Kenya_subset, Liberia_subset, Niger_subset, Rwanda_subset, Zambia_subset)
write.csv(All_Combined, "Data/Processed/AllCountries_Processed.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```
